comment: Family rules for MiniMax-H3 acceleration LoRAs. First match wins, so the list is ordered most-specific first. 'trunk' is omitted where the filename should decide it (the core falls back to filename parsing), and 'build' is deliberately never set here -- the safetensors header is authoritative about the adaln width, which is what actually decides build compatibility.

rules.recipe: PDD 8 steps (nfe=4 is also officially endorsed) · sampler=euler · CFG=1.0 · SigmaShift 12.0/3.0 · sigmas must come from the PDD node output -> SamplerCustomAdvanced · strength 1.0/1.0 · remove other distilled LoRAs · do not stack step-cache
rules.note: Carries a PDD head group that a plain LoRA loader cannot read; must go through the PDD Acc Apply node, which only reads the models/pdd_acc/ folder

rules.recipe: LightX2V Ref2V turbo · CFG=1.0 · strength 1.0 (Kijai suggests 0.75) · 4-step build SigmaShift 12.0/3.0, 8-step 768p build 6.0/3.0 · fewer steps means weaker reference adherence
LightX2V FL2V turbo · CFG=1.0 · strength 1.0 · 4-step 768p build SigmaShift 6.0/3.0, 8-step build 6.0/3.0
larryvrh Turbo v4 (step600 EMA) · 6 steps is the author's recommendation · scheduler=simple · CFG=1.0 · SigmaShift 12.0 / 4-6 · strength 1.0 (community 0.6-0.8) · beyond 8 steps it gets over-sharp
DMAD 4 steps · CFG=1.0 · strength 0.75-1.0 · er_sde or sa_solver · fast motion blurs easily
HyperFlow 8 steps · manual 9-point sigma: 1.0, 0.931506, 0.839236, 0.703462, 0.5, 0.296538, 0.160764, 0.068494, 0.0 · or euler/normal · strength 1.0
PDMD few-step distillation · CFG=1.0 · strength 1.0 · steps per the file spec · check the file model card for the exact sigma grid
FastGen-PDD 4 steps · CFG=1.0 · strength 1.0 · this file is a low-rank conversion for the pruned base
TaoMate 3 steps (rank128) · CFG=1.0 (>1.0 burns) · sampler=euler · scheduler=simple/linear FlowMatch · strength 1.0 · only FL2VA is official; Ref2AV is unreleased

FastH3 4 steps (the VSA variant adds 80% sparse attention) · the step count is fixed · T2V / first-last-frame only; Ref2VA is not distilled · the official release is a checkpoint; LoRA conversion needs the FastVideo stack
Veda sparse-attention weights (Ref2VA r2va preview) · use with the BSAI-ComfyUI-VedaSparse nodes; not a plain LoRA load path
Veda sparse-attention weights (T2VA 8nfe preview) · use with the BSAI-ComfyUI-VedaSparse nodes
ELM LongLive 4 steps · CFG=1.0 · strength 1.0 · check the file model card for the step count and sigma grid
Wuli Turbo 4 steps · CFG=1.0 · strength 1.0 · check the file model card for the exact sigma grid
Few-step turbo distillation · CFG=1.0 · strength 1.0 (lower to 0.6-0.8 when noisy) · steps per the file spec · do not stack with other distilled LoRAs
